titulo: The stairs finally got a name
caption:
The stairs finally got a name

Mop and bins already had names. Stairs didn't. Now it did, and the list had no hole left.

On a shared list the empty line is the one nobody takes, and putting your name on it takes two seconds.

For whoever puts a name on the line nobody picked.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A hallway with a sign-up list of three cream rows on the right: mop with a gold dot, bins with a blue dot and stairs with no dot. A ink-black block figure with narrowed white eyes walks up from the left, its eyes go wide, it leans in and a black dot appears beside stairs and the whole row turns green. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text stays: me taking the line nobody picked.
